finding.headline: Kurtis from vendor V-07 are running small at the bust, and customers are returning them for fit at about twice the category rate.
finding.evidence: V-07 Kurtis have a fit-return rate of 19 percent against a category median of 9 percent, and 138 of 172 fit returns say the kurti is too small. Fit returns rise with size, from 10 percent in S to 17 in M, 21 in L and 29 in XL, and customer quotes keep mentioning a tight bust.
finding.suggested_fix: Move the V-07 Kurtis size chart measurements one size down, or add "order one size up" to the listing.

finding.headline: V-12 Dresses are returned for coming up shorter than shown, with length the main complaint.
finding.evidence: The fit-return rate is 16 against a category median of 8, and 83 of 104 fit returns say the dress is too short. XL is highest at 22, while S and M are at 14 and L is at 15.
finding.suggested_fix: Add garment length in cm to the V-12 Dresses listing and show the item on a taller model.

finding.headline: Vendor V-03 Kids tees run large, with returns for poor fit well above the category norm.
